messages:
Maria: Heads-up — ZenPay is seeing increased 503s on the dedicated pool (pool-zenpay-eu-west) starting ~06:15 UTC. CS escalated as P1. Saw this after yesterday's routing weight change. Need short-term mitigation (4-6h) + owner for permanent fix.
Tom: On it. Can someone paste the spike graph or alert id? Which exact pool you mentioned?
Maria: pool-zenpay-eu-west — QPS steady but tail p99 > 2.5s and then 503s. Grafana: https://grafana.local/d/zenpay/latency (CS provided screenshots). Checkout flows failing.
Sara: Confirming from CS — multiple merchants reporting ~10% failed payments. They want an ETA for mitigation.
Devon: Putting oncall on this. Immediate plan: 1) revert yesterday's routing weight change for ZenPay 2) bump autoscale min pods 2->4 for that pool 3) enable fallback to smaller model variant. I'll take 1 & 2 now. Need @Tom to confirm variant compatibility for 3.
Tom: I can validate variant. Which variant are we talking about? small-emu-8b-quant? Also are we sure prefix-KV caching wasn't disabled in the runtime tweak? That would blow up p99.
Asha: Releases can push a routing revert hotpatch in ~10-15m if we have sign-off. Need product approval to adjust weights for a customer.
Maria: Leon (product on-call) approved a temporary revert for ZenPay. @Asha proceed once autoscale bump is confirmed by @Devon.
Devon: Autoscale min bumped, checking pod status. Seeing repeated OOMs on some infer containers — restarts line up with the 503 spikes. I'll isolate the bad node and drain it.
Tom: OOMs point to a kernel/quant mismatch after the runtime tweak. I'll roll back the kernel flag in canary on 2 nodes first.
Tom: Here's the quick rollback I plan to run:
```
kubectl -n inference apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: runtime-flags
data:
  kernel-override: 'stable-v2'
EOF
# then rollout restart ds/inference-runtime
```
Devon: Please paste the exact command when you run it. I'll coordinate draining and watch for restarts.
Asha: Deploying routing revert now (reverting weights for pool-zenpay-eu-west). ETA ~8m.
ops-bot (deploy-bot): routing-config revert started by @Asha at 06:38 UTC — CI checks passed, applying to cluster.
Maria: Notifying CS to tell customers mitigation ETA ~30m. Tracking permanent fix in INF-4876. Need an owner for the root cause and an EOD timeline for the fix.
Tom: I'll own INF-4876. Plan: validate kernel + quantization matrices, PR + canary by 18:00 UTC. If we can't stabilize the current runtime, fallback plan is to permanently route ZenPay to small-emu-8b-quant until we finish deeper validation.
Sara: I'll update the merchants with the 30m ETA and will ping once the mitigation is live.
Devon: Monitoring now — p50/p95 improved after routing revert and node drain. p99 still elevated but 503 rate trending down. I'll keep the incident open and update every 15m.
Maria: Thanks all. I'll summarize for execs and CS. If anyone is handing off later, add notes here. :thumbsup:
Tom: Quick note — I saw a couple of long GC pauses in the logs before the OOMs, will include heap tuning in the INF-4876 plan.
Asha: Routing revert completed and verified in prod for pool-zenpay-eu-west. Observability shows reduced error rate.
Devon: Still watching p99 and pod restarts, but error rate ~back to baseline. Will close when stable for 1h.
Sara: Merchant update sent. They appreciate the quick response.
Maria: Closing loop: owner assigned (@Tom), immediate mitigation applied (@Asha/@Devon), CS informed (@Sara). Keep this thread for follow-ups and the INF-4876 PR references.
